brief: A cabinet of three cells with two drawers, one of them shown pulled open.
costSource: token-equivalent at Muse Spark Open shared rates, info only: the Dedicated Endpoint bills GPU seconds while up (.spend/modal-dedicated.jsonl)

requirements.evidence: Build uses 4 bases totalling 3 cell volumes: piece:0,0,0;full and piece:0,0,1;full (2 full cells stacked) + piece:1,0,0;half-s and piece:1,0,1;half-s (2 half-bases stacked = 1 full cell). Top closed with cover:0,0,1;full;top and cover:1,0,1;half-s;top. Verified by get_build counts: piece=4 (2 full + 2 half-s).
Two drawers installed on the half-bases: drawer:0#1,0#cut at level 0 and drawer:1#1,0#cut at level 1, both using addDrawer key ‘n’ on cut face of half-s bases.

requirements.requirement: One of them shown pulled open
requirements.evidence: Top drawer drawer:1#1,0#cut set to open=true via setDrawerOpen, bottom drawer left closed (default). Check_build meshClash clear and look from az35/polar62 shows cabinet form with one drawer extended.

finish.summary: Built a 3-cell cabinet as a 2-high stack: a full-hex column (2 cells) beside a half-hex column (2 half-bases = 1 cell). Two classic drawers fitted to the half-bases; the upper drawer set open (true) and the lower remains closed. Capped open faces and locked joints, top covered. Checked and mesh-clear.

lines.label: Edge cap · male, two stories tall
M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
